_note: Tier 2, oldest end. 6-11 November 2025: the New York burning sessions.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees money funnelling, stiff-necked people with a bad agenda, darkness in the corners, and what look like medical or bio labs and science projects.
mentions.quote: I see labs. They look like bio labs
mentions.falsify_match: Funded biological laboratories exposed as part of the money trail he describes.
mentions.falsify_miss: None exposed. No country or facility is named.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a race between China and another country the Lord told him not to name, competing to perfect a new industrial revolution.
mentions.quote: the Lord said do not mention the other country
mentions.falsify_match: A two-nation race to engineer altered humans becoming public.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The second party is withheld by instruction, which removes half of what could be checked.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has seen a mass exodus of rich people leaving New York over decisions to be made in future, and New York City on fire with fires throughout, including the Statue of Liberty in view.
mentions.quote: I saw New York City on fire
mentions.falsify_match: Citywide fires in New York and an exodus of high net worth residents.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. Undated, and given four days after the mayoral election when wealth-flight commentary was saturating the news.

mentions.claim_text: He says hundreds of thousands were leaving New York City in the vision, and that the Lord showed him David Wilkerson and told him to remember what he said.
mentions.quote: hundreds of thousands of people were leaving New York City
mentions.falsify_match: Hundreds of thousands leaving New York City, which is measurable in census and移 migration data.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such outflow. He names Wilkerson as the source, whose 1973 vision of New York burning is where the image comes from.

mentions.claim_text: Reading Wilkerson, he gives at least a thousand fires burning in every borough, businesses on the brink moving out, and a hemorrhage already under way.
mentions.quote: at least a thousand fires burning in every borough
mentions.falsify_match: Not his claim: he is reading David Wilkerson aloud, so the thousand fires figure is Wilkerson's.

mentions.claim_text: The Wilkerson text he reads says it is not too far off, that no planes or trains will come into the city for about two weeks, and that all who have money will escape.
mentions.quote: There will be no planes, trains, anything coming in this city
mentions.falsify_match: Not his claim: continued reading of Wilkerson.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not his claim. Recorded so the two week transport shutdown has a provenance if he later recalls it as his.

mentions.claim_text: He says the calamities are messages and God is saying wake up, and that when he heard the Wilkerson word he recognised it as exactly what he saw, thousands of fires burning.
mentions.quote: that is exactly what I saw. I saw thousands of fires burning
mentions.falsify_match: Thousands of fires in New York City.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Note the direction of borrowing: he confirms his vision against a text he has just read, rather than the other way round.

mentions.claim_text: He says mystery Babylon is coming and that although many hold it to be Rome or elsewhere, the Lord said otherwise, acknowledging the reading is controversial.
mentions.quote: Mystery Babylon is coming
mentions.falsify_match: New York identifiable as the mystery Babylon of Revelation 18.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is not. An interpretive identification rather than a datable event.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a man being buried and going home, notes he is old so it would be no shock, and calls himself a prophet of confirmation.
mentions.quote: I saw him being buried and I saw him going
mentions.falsify_match: The death of the man in view.
mentions.falsify_miss: He lives. The subject is not named and he defuses the claim himself by pointing out the man is old.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is an uncovering coming, a light turned on to expose the cockroaches in the nation, and that he sees people making big relocation decisions.
mentions.quote: exposing the cockroaches that are in our nation
mentions.falsify_match: A wave of corruption exposures alongside internal migration.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw New York burning again, with small buildings, and smoke like burning tyres.
mentions.quote: when you light a bunch of tires on fire. That is the kind of smoke
mentions.falsify_match: Fires in New York matching the description.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is the job of the church to pray for leaders, governors and mayors, and tells New Yorkers they must pray for the man now in office.
mentions.quote: you people of New York, you must pray for that man
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an instruction to pray for the incoming mayor.

mentions.claim_text: He says they must pray against the Super Bowl, then describes seeing the New York subway system and the underwater tunnels blown up and flooded with water.
mentions.quote: I saw them blow up the underwater tunnels and they flooded them
mentions.falsify_match: An attack flooding the New York river tunnels.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A named city, named infrastructure and a named method, which makes this among the most specific security claims in the corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He says America is forty trillion dollars in the hole, asks about average credit card debt, and ties it to the beast system.
mentions.quote: We are $40 trillion dollars in the hole
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim: a debt figure stated. US federal debt passed 38 trillion dollars in October 2025, so forty trillion rounds up from the published number.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer calling revival in China, North Korea and Vietnam, saying many are under communism and the gospel must be preached to the whole world.
mentions.quote: We call for revival in China, in North Korea, in Vietnam
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition naming countries.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer for an impartation of the anointing so that sons and daughters rise up as warriors, and that this nation go before all the nations.
mentions.quote: YOUR WARRIORS WILL RISE UP IN THE NAME OF JESUS
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition.

mentions.claim_text: He calls a hedge of protection around the Macy's Thanksgiving Day parade, that no lorries run into people and there are no mass casualties.
mentions.quote: no semis or trucks trying to run into the people
mentions.falsify_match: A vehicle attack at the Macy parade in November 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurred. A named event on a fixed date, and it passed clean.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a man playing a keyboard, interceding and praying for America, and begins to recall an earlier telling.
mentions.quote: he was interceding and praying for America
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an image with no event attached.

mentions.claim_text: He says that while watching the deer the Lord began speaking to him about the Supreme Court justices, recalling that he had been told something was being given.
mentions.quote: he started talking to me about the Supreme Court justices
mentions.falsify_match: A change on the Supreme Court.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The content of what was said is not given in this passage.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord corrected him and told him he must speak, that America must, and that this must take place for the glorious outpouring and for a window of opportunity.
mentions.quote: THIS MUST TAKE PLACE FOR THE GLORIOUS OUTPOURING
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an instruction to speak, with the thing that must take place left unnamed here.

mentions.claim_text: He cites Mary at Cana telling the servants to do whatever he says, and notes that everyone circumstance will be different.
mentions.quote: WHATEVER HE TELLS YOU TO DO, do it
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: teaching from John 2.

mentions.claim_text: He says it should shake them and that it is not just about America but about Australia, England and infiltration.
mentions.quote: This is about Australia. This is about England. This is about infiltration
mentions.falsify_match: Foreign infiltration exposed in Australia and England.
mentions.falsify_miss: None exposed. No actor or institution is named.

mentions.claim_text: He reads that an order of 700 million ounces of silver from China to the UK was not fulfilled, and relays another man opinion about silver.
mentions.quote: 700 million oz of silver did not get filled
mentions.falsify_match: Not his claim: a market story read out, with someone else opinion attached. Annual world silver mine supply is about 800 million ounces, so a single unfilled order of 700 million would be nearly a year of global output.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that hearts be worked on overnight and a decision be made by tomorrow, over the politicians and what is going on in America.
mentions.quote: this decision will be made by tomorrow
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition about a pending vote, which is not identified.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer for covering over the airways from Oklahoma City to Atlanta and Texas, and that they pass a decent budget and stop this now.
mentions.quote: We call them to pass a decent budget
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition during the November 2025 shutdown and the associated flight reductions.

mentions.claim_text: He says decisions people face daily will challenge their way of society and their way of life, and prays for peace over America.
mentions.quote: it is going to challenge our way of society
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: a challenge to a way of life with no threshold or measure.

mentions.claim_text: He says that looking into New York he sees fire again, like something out of a Mad Max film, with fires burning in the buildings and the Statue of Liberty in view.
mentions.quote: I see fire again in New York
mentions.falsify_match: Widespread fires in New York City.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The fourth telling of the same image in three days.

mentions.claim_text: He says great hell is coming on the earth, that New York does not even look livable for the amount of fire, and that he is having an open-eyed vision while speaking to camera.
mentions.quote: New York does not even look livable. There is so much fire
mentions.falsify_match: New York rendered uninhabitable by fire.

mentions.claim_text: He turns to an altar call, asking where viewers would spend eternity if they died tonight.
mentions.quote: There is a heaven to gain and a hell to shun
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an altar call.

mentions.claim_text: He opens by saying he wants to go over what the Lord showed him the previous day about the towers, and that there was a lot shown.
mentions.quote: what the Lord showed me real fast yesterday about the towers
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: session framing pointing back to the towers material.
